name: Agent Desktop & Real-Time Co-Pilot
description: Unified single-pane-of-glass agent workspace augmented with a real-time AI co-pilot that listens to live transcripts, surfaces next-best-response knowledge cards, enforces compliance checklists, and automates after-call work (ACW) summarization.
roleInCenter: Frontline cockpit and co-pilot: eliminates swivel-chair app switching, drafts grounded responses in real time, and automates wrap-up notes and dispositions so agents focus on the customer.

glossary.definition: Single-pane-of-glass interface consolidating omnichannel media controls, customer 360 context, knowledge assist, and core transaction forms
Generative LLM synthesis producing structured problem-action-resolution notes, extracted entities, and recommended wrap codes at interaction end
Contextual knowledge snippet or drafted reply pushed to the agent screen within seconds of a detected customer question or objection
Automated execution of wrap-up tasks including disposition tagging, CRM case field population, and follow-up email drafting
Composite UI widgets and background API orchestrations that replace manual copy-pasting across 5 to 15 legacy billing, order, and ticketing screens
Dynamic on-screen tracker that checks off mandatory disclosures and verification phrases as the agent speaks them during the live call
Concise visual card displayed on screen pop summarizing prior IVR or virtual agent turns, authentication status, and customer sentiment
Non-intrusive desktop indicator alerting the agent to slow speech rate, avoid interruption, or acknowledge frustration when customer stress rises

metrics.name: Co-Pilot Assisted Average Handle Time
metrics.definition: Combined talk, hold, and wrap-up duration on interactions supported by real-time knowledge cards and automated ACW summarization

metrics.name: Co-Pilot Assisted FCR Rate
metrics.definition: First contact resolution rate on interactions where agents adopted surfaced knowledge or next-best-response cards

metrics.name: Co-Pilot Assisted Interaction CSAT
metrics.definition: Customer satisfaction score on contacts handled with real-time co-pilot guidance and zero repeat context questions

metrics.name: Desktop NBA Card Realized Value
metrics.definition: Mean contact value generated when agents execute real-time retention or expansion prompts surfaced in the desktop co-pilot

metrics.name: Auto-Summary Agent Acceptance Rate
metrics.definition: Percentage of AI-generated call summaries accepted by agents with minimal manual editing prior to CRM commit

failureModes.name: Co-Pilot Card Spam & Cognitive Overload
failureModes.signal: Agents ignore or minimize the co-pilot panel because noisy, low-relevance cards pop up on every sentence
failureModes.mitigation: Gate card pops on high intent-shift confidence, cap active cards to two on screen, and suppress duplicates

failureModes.name: Unreviewed Auto-Summary Factual Drift
failureModes.signal: Incorrect dollar amounts or promised dates appear in CRM case notes because agents click save without reviewing the generated summary
failureModes.mitigation: Highlight extracted numbers and commitments in bold review chips requiring explicit agent confirmation before CRM write

failureModes.name: Late Knowledge Card Arrival
failureModes.signal: Co-pilot surfaces the correct policy card 15 seconds after the agent already placed the customer on hold to search manually
failureModes.mitigation: Stream partial ASR transcripts with sub-2-second semantic cache lookup on top 200 recurring intents

failureModes.name: Incomplete Screen-Pop Context Hydration
failureModes.signal: Agent answers call to a blank workspace or spinning loader, forcing manual account lookup and extending handle time
failureModes.mitigation: Pre-hydrate CRM profile and bot handoff brief during ACD ring state with cached fallback views
